messages.fullAnnouncement:
☣️ THE INFECTION HAS BEGUN ☣️
@everyone
Patient Zero is loose in Huss Valley...
🧟 💉 Infected Knife Outbreak
David, Albie, xMc and Tony are carrying the Infected Knife. If they catch you, you're infected too and you obtain The Infected Knife! Then it's YOUR job to spread it killing others with the Infected knife to spread it more! Track the outbreak live on the world map as it spreads server to server.
🌍 📈 Global Milestones
The more players infected, the stronger EVERY Infected Knife gets: new VFX, a zombie kill effect and an exclusive title at 100%! Spread it yourself to earn personal rewards too.
⛓️ NEW: SOULBINDER BUNDLE ⛓️
Death is only the beginning...
💀 👻 Soul Reap ability: fallen teammates leave their soul behind. Reap it and their ghost follows you around... and they're NOT happy about it.
🛡️ Every soul you carry is a free life. Get caught and a soul is spent instead, freezing the catcher in place!
🔪 Includes the Soulbinder knife, the Soul Call emote, candy and more! Available now. Don't let their souls go to waste.
😈 ✨ New Rarity: MYTHICAL
The rarest tier yet has arrived. Good luck.
👀 🍬 New Crate Knives 🍬
3 new Trick Crate knives
3 new Treat Crate knives
🆘 New Item! Lifeline!
Catcher camping your body? Lifeline's got your back. Stay down too long with a catcher hovering over you and you'll get back up and back in the game. No more getting camped out of a round!
🗺️ New Map
The Valley - no abilities
🎁 New Code
Redeem INFECTION for free candy!
Who's getting infected first?
👇
